Annexure – “A” 
Press Release 
Maruti Suzuki sales in September 2026  
New Delhi, October 1, 2026: In September 2026, Maruti Suzuki India Limited sold a total of 236,013 units. Total sales 
in the month include domestic sales of 185,252 units, sales to other OEM of 6,542 units and exports of 44,219 units.  
The sales figures for September 2026 are given below:
